scripts.api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn makthai.main:app --reload
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.api:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:revision: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.api:node2: cd apps/api && NODE_ID=node2 uv run uvicorn makthai.main:app --reload --port 8001
